title: Configure one Read tool
explanation: This read-only experiment asks the agent to read one harmless classroom file. maxTurns: 1 forces the limited scenario. The hook restricts reads to the bundled guide.

title: Narrow system and init
explanation: Every system subtype is handled as a lifecycle event. Only init exposes init-specific fields. The browser receives an allowlisted projection, with the working directory reduced to a classroom label.

title: Inspect assistant blocks
explanation: The SDK wrapper contains message.message.content. Tool requests are keyed by their actual ID. Text appears in the complete-block panel. Thinking and other non-text content are identified without displaying their content.

title: Match user tool results
explanation: A user message can be tool feedback rather than a person typing. Its tool_use_id joins the earlier request. The elapsed time measures receipt-to-receipt observation, including runtime scheduling; it is not a provider billing duration.

title: Extract text deltas safely
explanation: Check three nested discriminators before reading text. Complete assistant blocks still arrive, so this app uses a separate incremental panel and never appends the complete text to that panel.

title: Read the typed result
explanation: The success subtype has result; error subtypes have errors[]. Check is_error as well: a success-shaped message can carry an API error. A refusal is visible in stop_reason. usage describes the main loop; modelUsage contains broader query-pipeline totals when present.

title: Consume through trailing events
explanation: Do not break at the result. Preserve a typed outcome if the single-prompt runtime subsequently throws. An exception before any result remains a failure; no result is invented.

title: Close the query reliably
explanation: The finally block closes the real SDK query. The host streams only the projected observations. Private configuration and dependency folders are not served by the static router.
